query: SELECT Med_drug.indication, Med_institution.international_collaboration, Med_disease.prognosis, Med_drug.recommended_usage FROM disease JOIN institution ON disease.disease_name = institution.research_diseases JOIN drug ON disease.disease_name = drug.disease_name WHERE (Med_drug.indication != 'constipation' AND Med_disease.diagnosis_challenges != 'lack of accurate diagnostic test') OR (Med_drug.single_dose = 'adult patients with EGPA 3x100 mg' AND Med_disease.sequelae != 'gangrene');
note: SQL本身只有结构化算子；SExtract是从原文到关系的分析性补充，不是源SQL的显式调用，也不表明每个字段必须由LLM抽取。字段类型、NULL及一对多抽取契约须在执行前固定。 源SQL存在未绑定表限定符：Med_disease, Med_drug, Med_institution；图原样保留，字段归属待核，不能直接执行。所需字段：Med_disease.diagnosis_challenges, Med_disease.prognosis, Med_disease.sequelae, Med_drug.indication, Med_drug.recommended_usage, Med_drug.single_dose, Med_institution.international_collaboration, disease.disease_name, drug.disease_name, institution.research_diseases
